references.text: Samson strikes the Philistines with great power, demonstrating his supernatural strength given by the Lord's Spirit.
Judas men come down to the Rock of Etam to hand Samson over to the Philistines, confirming the place where Samson was hiding.
Samson is brought up from the rock, showing that he truly stayed in the ravine at the Rock of Etam.
David hides in a cave, just as Samson sought refuge in a mountain ravine to escape his enemies.
David hides on cliffs and in fortresses to avoid Saul, similar to Samson's refuge in the mountain ravine at Etam.
